_comment: Per-model custom pricing, USD per MILLION tokens. Fill in your own negotiated/published rates. Keys are matched to a session's model ids first by EXACT id (e.g. 'claude-opus-4-8'), then by family normalisation ('claude-opus-4-8' -> 'claude-opus-4-x'). Unpriced models are warned about and left at $0.00 — never priced as another model. If your transcripts lack the 5m/1h cache split, cache_write tokens fall back to the cache_write_5m rate.
